oracle-l5r-10863.note: Isawa Tsumaro (Personality, issue #735): "Air Home Engage: Move your target Air Shugenja home. Create a 0F/3C/0PH Air - Illusion - Shugenja Personality at the current battlefield; remove him from the game after the battle ends. While the Illusion is there, abilities on the target's spells have Home." The created card is no longer a gap: Tsumaro's Illusion (oracle-l5r-11346, 0F/3C/0PH Air - Illusion - Shugenja) is published in personality-wave-145 (issue #677). Two pieces are missing. (1) Home (P16) waives only the source-at-the-battlefield checks of a Battle action: an Engage action is a Reaction after the engage (IsEngageAction), whose source must be at the battlefield, so a Home Engage from home is not a merged path. (2) "While the Illusion is there, abilities on the target's spells have Home" is a grant tied to a created card's presence (granted Home has a turn duration only; P10's rules read a source card's Effect, not a link from one created card to a chosen target's Spells). Publishing it without them would approximate the card, so it is left unpublished.

oracle-l5r-10347.note: Blood of Isawa's Tribe (Spell, issue #735): "After this card attaches: Choose an element keyword (Air, Earth, Fire, Void, Water) in this Shugenja's keywords or text. While this card is attached, replace all instances of that keyword on this Shugenja with another element keyword that you choose now." P10's ReplaceElementKeyword does the replacement, but the choice is the problem: it is a mandatory trait of the Spell (no "Reaction:" prefix) that needs two decisions in a row (which element, then which replacement) the moment the Spell attaches. Mandatory entry effects (ApplyMandatoryEntryEffects) are automatic and open no decision, and an optional Reaction would change the printed text from mandatory to optional. Opening a pending choice from inside the entry path (before the entry Reaction window, for an attach by Equip, Equip (Battle) or a search) is not a merged path, and "in this Shugenja's keywords or text" would also need a rule for the elements named in text. It is left unpublished rather than approximated.
